topics.label: Introduction to cancer hallmarks and lecture overview
topics.groupedBecause: This opening framing outlines the lecture structure, learning outcomes, and the conceptual framework of cancer hallmarks.

topics.label: Deregulated growth signaling pathways in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain how oncogenic mutations in cell surface receptor pathways drive autonomous proliferation and survival signaling.

topics.label: Differentiation blocks in hematological and solid tumors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore how cancer cells arrest in immature, proliferative states across both hematopoietic lineages and colonic epithelial crypts.

topics.label: Evasion of apoptosis through p53 and BCL2 family deregulation
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic addresses how cancer cells evade programmed cell death through the disruption of p53 and the balance of mitochondrial apoptotic regulators.

topics.label: Replicative immortality, cellular senescence, and p53 stress surveillance
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how telomere shortening, senescence barriers, and p53 stress responses are bypassed to enable unlimited tumor cell replication.

topics.label: Metabolic reprogramming and oncometabolites in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics detail the shift toward aerobic glycolysis and the mechanisms by which altered cellular metabolism and oncometabolites influence the cancer epigenome.

topics.label: Tumor angiogenesis and vascular recruitment
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic explains how hypoxic tumor microenvironments activate the angiogenic switch to supply nutrients and oxygen necessary for expanded growth.

topics.label: Invasion, metastatic dissemination, and genomic evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics describe the physical processes, biological hurdles, clinical monitoring, and clonal genomic signatures associated with tumor metastasis.

topics.label: Conclusion and lecture wrap-up
topics.groupedBecause: This closing framing summarizes the major takeaways on cancer hallmarks and provides administrative wrap-up for the session.
